from ever creating their automation. A pre-existing balance is treated
as a donation — it is swept out by `cancel`.

docs: Epoch Vault fee accrued by this round's deploys, in USD base units.
Physically sits in the board's USD pool until swept at rotation.

fields.name: pending_one_btc_fee_usd_amount
docs: 1 BTC Vault fee accrued by this round's deploys; same lifecycle.

fields.name: pending_protocol_fee_usd_amount
docs: Protocol (treasury) fee accrued by this round's deploys; same lifecycle.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

types.name: RoundRevealed
docs: `rotate_round`: the closed round's entropy-derived outcome.

fields.name: is_strike_triggered
docs: Whether the ~1/1440 strike jackpot draw fired for this round (its funds
roll into the round's payout pools).

fields.name: epoch_fee_usd_amount
docs: The round's accumulated fee legs, the exact sums of the per-deploy
legs. The strike fee stays in the board pool as jackpot; the other
three are swept to their pools at this reveal.

types.name: RoundStakeSwapped
docs: `swap_round_stake`: the round's final post-swap pools — the payout
numerators for every claim, measured from the opaque aggregator route.

fields.name: version
docs: Struct version.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for the config account.

fields.name: owner_authority
docs: Owner of the program. Can change ownership and set the admin of the program.

fields.name: admin_authority
docs: Current update authority address for both Config and other PDAs - can be updated.

fields.name: round_authority
docs: Address of the authority controlling the round flow.

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: Protocol fees recipient address.

fields.name: usd_mint
docs: USD mint address, initially USDC

fields.name: btc_mint
docs: BTC mint address, initially cbBTC

fields.name: strike_fee_bps
docs: Strike jackpot fee in basis points.

fields.name: epoch_fee_bps
docs: Epoch Vault fee in basis points.

fields.name: one_btc_fee_bps
docs: 1 BTC Vault fee in basis points.

fields.name: sats_vault_round_fee_bps
docs: Sats Vault fee in basis points.

fields.name: sats_vault_claim_fee_bps
docs: Sats Vault claim fee in basis points.

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: Protocol fee in basis points.

fields.name: unclaimed_hashrate_bps
docs: Share of each settled play's hashrate reward deferred until the sats claim in basis points.

fields.name: min_deploy_usd_amount
docs: Minimum gross deploy size per round, manual or automated, in USD mint (6 decimals).

fields.name: epoch_vault_iteration_duration
docs: Epoch Vault iteration length in slots.

fields.name: deployment_settle_grace_duration
docs: Grace window, in slots after `Round::settled_at_slot`, during which
only the normal settle path applies; afterward stale deployments
become eligible for third-party cleanup

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved

types.name: SatsClaimed
docs: `claim_sats`: shares redeemed for BTC and the unclaimed-hashrate slice
converted by this claim.

fields.name: claimed_shares
docs: Shares burned by this claim.

fields.name: btc_received
docs: Net BTC transferred to the miner (after the vault claim fee).

fields.name: claimed_hashrate
docs: Unclaimed hashrate converted into `hashrate_amount`, proportional to
the share of the balance claimed.

fields.name: version
docs: Struct version

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

fields.name: btc_amount
docs: Total BTC backing outstanding shares. Together with `leftovers` it
mirrors the reserves: `sats_vault_btc_ata.amount == btc_amount + leftovers`.

fields.name: btc_shares
docs: Total shares issued against `btc_amount`.

fields.name: leftovers
docs: BTC left behind by full drains (fees with no remaining holders). Sits in
`sats_vault_btc_ata` but backs no shares; claimable by the protocol.
Invariant: `sats_vault_btc_ata.amount == btc_amount + leftovers`.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved

types.name: TileStake
docs: Per-tile accumulator, updated as public miners deploy. Lets the round derive
its winning-tile totals the instant the winning tile is revealed, removing the
need for a per-deployment settlement pass.

fields.name: stake
docs: Running sum of even-split USD stakes placed on this tile.

fields.name: deploy_count
docs: Number of deployments that selected this tile.

types.name: Treasury
docs: Singleton custodian of protocol fees and swept round pots. Fees land in the
treasury's USD ATA on every public deploy (a separate leg, so the ATA
balance always equals the accrued fees) and are withdrawn to the configured
`fee_recipient` by an admin crank. Swept pots are accumulated in both USD
and BTC ATAs.

fields.name: version
docs: Struct version.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

fields.name: pending_usd_amount
docs: USD protocol fees accrued and not yet withdrawn; mirrors the ATA balance.

fields.name: pending_btc_amount
docs: BTC swept from no-winner rounds and not yet withdrawn;

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

fields.name: page_index
docs: Page the winner was drawn from. Together with `tickets`, lets the reduced
(without-replacement) ticket ranges be reconstructed from the winners array
instead of a live per-page cache on the iteration.

fields.name: tickets
docs: Ticket weight removed from the draw when this winner was selected.
